chapter: Howard McGhee's band and bebop in LA
title: Streets of Paris, Kay Starr and Erroll Garner
summary: Working the Streets of Paris basement, with the Four Blazers and Kay Starr, and Garner across the street.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Across the street, when we later worked at the Streets of Paris, which was downstairs where they had the bandstand inside of this round bar, we'd sit up high... When we first worked there, it was a group there called the Hollywood Four Blazers, which was a very fine group, alternating with us.
And the next group that came in to alternate with us, like our intermission group, was Kay Starr and her group. That was before she ever recorded!

And in the meantime, Erroll Garner had just come out. He was working diagonally across the street at the Suzy Q. He had just won the Esquire Poll and everything, it was his first trip to California, and he was doing real good. That's when I first met him. And...
Right, it was on the northeast corner, and the Suzy Q was on the southwest corner. And right down the street, in the basement, was The Streets of Paris, where we worked with Howard's group.
